36: static void on_enter_state(fm_session_t *sess, fm_event_t evt)
37: {

41:   if (sess->state == FM_FOCUSING) {

43:   } else if (sess->state == FM_PAUSED ||
44:              sess->state == FM_INTERRUPTED ||
45:              sess->state == FM_COMPLETED) {
46:     focus_timer_stop();
47:   }
48: 
49:   switch (sess->state) {
50:   case FM_INTERRUPTED:
51:     /* Active scene: the device sensed the phone was taken away and
52:      * auto-paused — the user said nothing. */
53:     if (sess->current_stage >= 0 && sess->current_stage < sess->stage_count) {
54:       printf("[FocusMate] !!! 检测到手机被取走，专注已自动暂停 !!!\n");
55:       printf("[FocusMate]     当前任务: %s (第 %d/%d 阶段)\n",

57:              sess->current_stage + 1, sess->stage_count);
58:       printf("[FocusMate]     已保存进度，中断次数 +1 (%d)\n",
59:              sess->interrupt_count);
60:     }
61:     break;
62: 
63:   case FM_RECOVERING:
64:     /* Active scene: phone put back — proactively ask to resume. */
65:     if (sess->current_stage >= 0 && sess->current_stage < sess->stage_count) {
66:       printf("[FocusMate] 欢迎回来！手机已放回。\n");
67:       printf("[FocusMate]     刚才正在: %s (第 %d/%d 阶段)\n",
68:              sess->stages[sess->current_stage].title,
69:              sess->current_stage + 1, sess->stage_count);
70:       printf("[FocusMate]     是否继续？输入 resume 继续，cancel 放弃。\n");
71:     }
72:     break;
73: 
74:   case FM_COMPLETED: {
75:     char summary[256];
76:     focus_agent_summarize(sess, summary, sizeof(summary));
77:     printf("[FocusMate] %s\n", summary);
78:     /* M8: archive the finished session, then clear the current one so a
79:      * restart does not offer to resume an already-finished task. */
80:     focus_storage_append_history(sess);
81:     focus_storage_clear();
82:     break;
83:   }
84: 
85:   default:
86:     break;
87:   }
88: 
89:   /* Keep the on-screen UI in step with every state change. */
90:   focus_ui_refresh(sess);
91: }

93: /* Called once per second by the timer while FOCUSING (M5).
94:  * Uses \r so the countdown overwrites itself on the same line,
95:  * keeping the CLI readable between commands. */
96: static void on_tick(void)
97: {
98:   int stage_total, remain, pct;
99: 
100:   if (g_session.state != FM_FOCUSING) {
101:     return;
102:   }
103:   if (g_session.current_stage >= 0 &&
104:       g_session.current_stage < g_session.stage_count) {
105:     stage_total = g_session.stages[g_session.current_stage].minutes * 60;
106:     remain = stage_total - g_session.stage_elapsed_seconds;
107:     pct = stage_total > 0
108:               ? (g_session.stage_elapsed_seconds * 100) / stage_total
109:               : 0;
110:     if (remain < 0) {
111:       remain = 0;
112:     }
113:     if (pct > 100) {
114:       pct = 100;
115:     }
116:     printf("\r[FocusMate] [%d/%d] %s  剩余 %02d:%02d  进度 %d%%   ",
117:            g_session.current_stage + 1, g_session.stage_count,
118:            g_session.stages[g_session.current_stage].title,
119:            remain / 60, remain % 60, pct);
120:   }
121:   fflush(stdout);
122: 
123:   /* Push the same countdown onto the AMOLED once per second. */
124:   focus_ui_refresh(&g_session);
125: }

2:  * app/focusmate/core/focus_state.h
3:  *
4:  * FocusMate state machine: states, events, and transition handling.
5:  * All external inputs (UI, timer, sensor, storage) are converted into
6:  * events and fed to focus_state_handle_event(); the state machine decides
7:  * transitions and what actions to run.

10: #ifndef FOCUS_STATE_H
11: #define FOCUS_STATE_H
12: 
13: #include <stdbool.h>
14: #include <stdint.h>
15:

18: #endif

20: /* ── FocusMate states ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
21: 
22: typedef enum {
23:   FM_IDLE,        /* waiting for goal input */
24:   FM_PLANNING,    /* AI is generating a structured plan */
25:   FM_READY,       /* plan ready, waiting for user to start */
26:   FM_FOCUSING,    /* actively focusing on current stage */
27:   FM_PAUSED,      /* user paused manually */
28:   FM_INTERRUPTED, /* phone removed / external interruption */
29:   FM_RECOVERING,  /* phone returned, prompting user to resume */
30:   FM_COMPLETED    /* all stages finished */
31: } fm_state_t;

33: /* ── Events ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
34: 
35: typedef enum {

# FocusMate Developer Note — States & Transitions

Eight states, all driven by `fm_state_handle_event()` (core/focus_state.c).

| # | State | Meaning | Enters via event |
|---|-------|---------|------------------|
| 1 | `IDLE` | waiting for goal, or reset point | `CANCEL` (from most states), `PLAN_FAILED` |
| 2 | `PLANNING` | AI/local planner is building the plan | `GOAL_SUBMITTED` |
| 3 | `READY` | plan ready, waiting to start | `PLAN_READY` |
| 4 | `FOCUSING` | actively focusing on a stage | `START`; `RESUME` (from PAUSED/RECOVERING); `STAGE_TIMEOUT` when a stage remains |
| 5 | `PAUSED` | user paused manually | `PAUSE` |
| 6 | `INTERRUPTED` | phone taken away; auto-paused | `PHONE_REMOVED` |
| 7 | `RECOVERING` | phone returned, prompt to resume | `PHONE_RETURNED`; `RESTORE` (saved session) |
| 8 | `COMPLETED` | all stages finished | `STAGE_TIMEOUT`/`SESSION_FINISHED` on last stage |

Flow: `IDLE → PLANNING → READY → FOCUSING ↔ PAUSED`,
`FOCUSING → INTERRUPTED → RECOVERING → FOCUSING`, `FOCUSING → COMPLETED`.
`CANCEL` returns any active state to `IDLE`; `RESTORE` resumes a saved session at `RECOVERING`.
